user_input: Our team is deciding whether to rewrite our core monolith into Kubernetes microservices hosted on AWS or keep our current single Postgres + monolithic service on an existing bare-metal server. The monolith is getting slightly harder to deploy and takes 15 minutes to run integration tests, but we have never experienced customer-facing downtime. Several junior developers are pushing hard for microservices because they want experience with modern distributed systems on their resumes. I believe that since everyone is using microservices, we will definitely struggle to hire future engineers if we stay on our monolith. We have a 4-month runway to release our next major product milestone.
options: Refactor monolith into Kubernetes microservices on AWS
Keep and optimize existing monolith on bare-metal server
context: Stated priorities: Fast delivery of product milestone in 4 months, operational stability, and developer hiring/retention.
